name: pi
description: Installs Pi coding agent on Wolfi base images and optionally copies selected Pi agent configuration into the container running user's home.

version.description: Select the Pi coding agent version to install.

packageManager.description: Package manager to use when installing Pi. Auto prefers existing pnpm, then existing npm, then installs npm.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version to install when Pi installation requires adding Node tooling. Existing node installations are reused.

copySettings.description: Whether to copy Pi settings.json from the host into the container.

copyAuth.description: Whether to copy Pi auth.json from the host into the container.

copyModels.description: Whether to copy Pi models.json from the host into the container.

copyKeybindings.description: Whether to copy Pi keybindings.json from the host into the container.

copyInstructions.description: Whether to copy Pi instruction files (AGENTS.md, SYSTEM.md, APPEND_SYSTEM.md) from the host into the container.

copyPrompts.description: Whether to copy Pi prompt templates from the host into the container.

copySkills.description: Whether to copy Pi skills from the host into the container.

copyExtensions.description: Whether to copy Pi extensions from the host into the container.

copyThemes.description: Whether to copy Pi themes from the host into the container.

copyAll.description: Whether to copy all supported Pi agent content from the host into the container. Package directories, sessions, and logs are never copied.
